The text that asks the agent to fix a draft

Source: R/check_spec.R
tfl_check_fix_text.Rd

For each report tfl_check_spec() put at ERROR or WARNING, the text to paste into the agent's chat: which file, which report, what is wrong where (each error and warning row), and what not to change – the common rules are in ai/AGENTS.md and the instructions, which the text names rather than repeats. In English, or in Japanese (language = "ja"); tflspec's own messages stay as they are.

Usage

tfl_check_fix_text(problems, language = "en", output_id = NULL)

Arguments

problems

tfl_check_spec()'s result.

language

"en" (default) or "ja" ("Japanese" too).

output_id

The reports to write the text for; NULL (default): every report at ERROR or WARNING.

Value

A character vector named by report id, one text a report (its lines joined with newlines); empty when no report needs a fix.

See also

tfl_check_spec(), tfl_check_reports()
